brief: Interactive mental-math trainer for John Conway's Doomsday Rule — calculating the weekday of any date in seconds.

concepts.name: Mod-7 Grid
concepts.idea: Seven modular calendar units (6 rounded tiles + 1 circular Doomsday anchor node) arranged in a 2-3-2 grid forming a D.
rationale: Encodes the 7-day week and modulo-7 arithmetic into a clean geometric D without literal calendar or brain clichés.
Echoes Daywise's dark dotted-matrix UI and pairs the Emerald anchor node (#34D399 / #059669) with high-contrast monochrome tiles.
Includes an optically thinned dark-mode cut (daywise-symbol-dark.svg) and a wider-gap small-size cut (daywise-symbol-small.svg) for 16 px favicons.

recommendation: Final approved Mod-7 Grid identity kit for Daywise.
